title: Mission Aarogya
metaDescription: Mission Aarogya by Being Sevak Charitable Trust provides healthcare support, medical assistance, emergency aid and wellness initiatives for underprivileged communities across India.

content.description: Mission Aarogya by Being Sevak Charitable Trust provides healthcare support, medical assistance, emergency aid and wellness initiatives for underprivileged communities across India.

content.text: Our mission supports heart patients, children and old age people by helping them during medical emergencies, hospital treatments and critical healthcare situations with compassion and care.

items.title: Heart Patient Help
items.description: Supporting heart patients with emergency medical assistance.

items.title: Child Healthcare
items.description: Helping small children receive proper hospital treatment.

items.title: Old Age Support
items.description: Providing healthcare help for elderly people in need.

items.title: Hospital Assistance
items.description: Helping needy families with treatment and hospital support.

cards.title: Washroom Renovation
cards.description: We renovate old school and college toilets to provide students with clean, safe and hygienic washroom facilities.

cards.title: Clean Water Filters
cards.description: Installing clean drinking water filters to ensure healthy and safe water access for students and staff members.

cards.title: Kitchen & Wash Basin Support
cards.description: We help schools by building new kitchens, wash basins and hygiene areas for better cleanliness and student wellbeing.

content.heading: Safe Feeding Spaces For Mothers & Babies
content.text: Our Baby Care Center initiative creates safe and comfortable feeding spaces where mothers can feed and care for their babies peacefully in public places with privacy, hygiene and proper support.

items.title: Baby Feeding Rooms
items.description: Providing clean and safe feeding areas for mothers and babies.

items.title: Mother Support
items.description: Helping mothers with comfortable care facilities in public places.

items.title: Hygienic Environment
items.description: Maintaining cleanliness and safety for newborn baby care.

items.title: Public Care Centers
items.description: Setting up baby care centers at different public locations.

content.title: Health is the True Wealth
content.description: Your donation provides healthcare, medical support and wellness services to underprivileged communities across India.

items.quote: Being Sevak is doing incredible work for healthcare and needy families. Proud to support this mission.
